_doc: Step 27, the canonical 40-machine catalog (generated by tools/catalog/build_catalog.py -- edit there). A machine whose `requires` lists a system the game does not have yet cannot be built and does nothing (no invented benefit); `runtime` names the model type of the ones that run today.

machines.name: Kernel Hopper Loader
machines.motion: kernels trickle down a funnel into the kettles
machines.operation: keeps every auto kettle on the floor supplied with kernels
outputs: kernels in each kettle's hopper
machines.queue: one hopper feeds up to 4 kettles
machines.marginal: without kernels an auto kettle starves; with the hopper it never waits for a refill

machines.name: Precision Oil Doser
machines.motion: a drop of oil falls with each cycle
machines.operation: measures oil into each auto lot
outputs: the lot's grade odds: late becomes near
machines.marginal: quality 60 -> 80 on the late share of auto lots

machines.name: Heat Controller
machines.motion: a needle steadies on a gauge
machines.operation: holds the auto kettles' heat steady
outputs: no burnt auto lots
machines.queue: covers the kettles on its row
machines.marginal: burnt auto lots (yield 0.25) disappear once auto heat can vary

machines.name: Agitation Motor
machines.motion: a shaft turns inside the kettle
machines.operation: stirs each auto lot so it pops evenly
outputs: one more portion per lot
machines.marginal: an auto lot of ~2.1 portions makes ~3.1 (+48% from the same kernels)

machines.name: Pop Detector
machines.motion: an eye blinks when the popping slows
machines.operation: takes the auto lot out at the right moment
outputs: no late auto lots (they come out near)
machines.marginal: late share (30%) becomes near: +0.6 portion and +20 quality per such lot

machines.name: Batch Ejector
machines.motion: an arm tips the kettle into the tube
machines.operation: moves lots from the kettle glass into the lift at once

contract.applies_to: the hand kettle and auto kettles

outputs: the lot in the lift sooner
machines.marginal: the kettle's glass frees 0.6 s sooner each lot (the hand pops more often when the bin is the limit)

machines.name: Dual Kettle Sequencer
machines.motion: a second kettle cooks while the first pours
machines.operation: runs an auto kettle: a lot every cycle
outputs: a lot of popcorn (real portions)
machines.queue: holds its lot when the bin is full
machines.marginal: ~21 portions a minute (tier 0)

machines.name: Cooling/Recovery Fan
machines.motion: fan blades spin after each pop
machines.operation: cools the kettles faster after a pop

contract.applies_to: the hand kettle and auto kettles' turnaround

outputs: shorter cooldown
machines.marginal: a fast hand pops ~5% more often

machines.name: Kernel Sorter
machines.motion: a sieve shakes out unpopped kernels
machines.operation: re-pops the unpopped kernels of early or late lots (the hand's and the kettles')
outputs: the same lot at near grade, one portion fewer
machines.queue: between the kettles and the lift
machines.marginal: quality 50/60 -> 80 for a portion each

machines.name: Multi-Pot Distributor
machines.motion: pipes branch to several pots
machines.operation: lets more kettles share the floor's places
outputs: two more kitchen places (three, four at its tiers)
machines.queue: one place; its extra places must be empty to sell it
machines.marginal: more kettles where the kitchen's places were the limit

machines.name: Quality Sensor
machines.motion: a light sorts lots left and right
machines.operation: sends top-quality lots to a premium SKU
outputs: premium packs (price x1.2), sold only to customers who ask for premium
machines.queue: premium and plain never share a pack
machines.marginal: perfect hand lots and tuned kettle lots sell for 20% more

machines.name: Flavor Base Mixer
machines.motion: a whisk turns in a bowl
machines.operation: premixes the flavor base for flavored lots
outputs: every coater's batch 1.0/1.4/1.8 s shorter (never below half)
machines.marginal: caramel and cocoa batches (10-12 s) come out sooner where the coater is the limit

machines.name: Vent Stabilizer
machines.motion: vents breathe in turn
machines.operation: prevents overheating when many kettles run
outputs: no overheat stops
machines.marginal: three or more kettles keep cooking instead of stopping to cool

machines.name: Heat Recycler
machines.motion: a coil glows while kettles run
machines.operation: returns heat to the kettles
outputs: 1 coin a minute less upkeep per cooking kettle (never below 1)
machines.marginal: -25% kettle upkeep at tier 0

machines.name: Smart Job Dispatcher
machines.motion: a screen points kettles at jobs
machines.operation: starts a kettle's next lot only when the shelf and the orders need it (later also which flavor)
inputs: the shelf's counts, the orders waiting
outputs: no lots nobody needs: kernels, oil and upkeep saved
machines.marginal: pays for itself when the kettles out-cook the shop

machines.name: Rotary Popper
machines.motion: a drum turns and pours a steady stream
machines.operation: a continuous kettle: small lots without a break
outputs: a small lot every 2.5 s
machines.queue: holds when the bin is full
machines.marginal: ~48 portions a minute

machines.name: Cup Feeder
machines.motion: a stack of cups lowers one at a time
machines.operation: fills one-portion cups, a product of its own (and the lone portion a bag would leave)
outputs: cup packs (a new SKU, price 6)
machines.marginal: a quarter of customers want a cup once cups exist

machines.name: Bag Dispenser
machines.motion: a flat bag opens and drops
machines.operation: supplies large bags without the twin-head station
outputs: the large bag on sale before the station's tier 2
machines.marginal: large-bag orders (35%) served from tier 1

machines.name: Volumetric Filler
machines.motion: a nozzle fills a bag by volume
machines.operation: packs wanted bags from real portions in the bin
outputs: a sealed pack on the shelf
machines.queue: holds a sealed pack while the shelf is full
machines.marginal: +12 packs a minute (tier 0)

machines.name: Portion Weigher
machines.motion: a pan dips and settles under each pack
machines.operation: weighs each filler's pack so no portion is given away
outputs: exact packs: the overfilled portion back in the bin, 0.5 s slower
machines.marginal: about one pack in seven keeps its extra portion

machines.name: Seasoning Sprayer
machines.motion: a mist of seasoning falls on the portions
machines.operation: seasons plain portions into a flavor
outputs: Cheese Crunch or Spicy Dust portions on its line
machines.queue: a batch of 4/6/8 portions at a time; coats only what orders and the shelf's flavor stock want
machines.marginal: a flavor's customers (8-22% of new ones) buy a bag worth 13-16 instead of leaving

machines.name: Caramel Coater
machines.motion: caramel cascades over a turning drum
machines.operation: coats portions with caramel or cocoa
outputs: Golden Caramel or Cocoa Swirl portions on its line
machines.queue: a slow batch of 4/6/8 portions; coats only what orders and the shelf's flavor stock want
machines.marginal: caramel (18) and cocoa (22) bags for the customers who ask for them

machines.name: Auto Sealer
machines.motion: jaws press and crimp each bag
machines.operation: seals packs apart from filling
outputs: the station's, the fillers' and the cup feeder's cycles 25/30/35% shorter
machines.marginal: a quarter more packs from the same heads

machines.name: Package Conveyor Diverter
machines.motion: an arm swings each pack to its lane
machines.operation: sends each SKU to its own shelf lane
outputs: premium packs on their own lane (2/3/4 places) -- they never take plain places (flavors' lanes later)
machines.marginal: plain keeps its whole shelf while premium waits

machines.name: Pickup Belt
machines.motion: a belt carries packs from the shelf to the counter
machines.operation: brings packs from the shelf to the counter
outputs: the counter's hand-over 0.6/0.8/1.0 s shorter
machines.marginal: a quarter more hand-overs a minute

machines.name: Order Ticket Printer
machines.motion: tickets curl out and hang over the queue
machines.operation: takes orders from the queue early
outputs: a customer whose pack is being made does not lose patience
machines.marginal: fewer customers leave while the station packs their bag

machines.name: Auto Cashier
machines.motion: coins clink into a drawer
machines.operation: takes payment apart from handing over
outputs: counter lanes free 35% sooner; payments one at a time (0.9/0.7/0.5 s)
machines.marginal: a third more counter throughput while the drawer keeps up

machines.name: Queue Router
machines.motion: a light points the next customer to a free lane
machines.operation: sends whoever's pack is ready to a free lane
outputs: no customer waits behind one whose pack is not ready
machines.marginal: mixed orders (cups, premium, large) stop blocking the line

machines.name: Express Window
machines.motion: a little window with its own bell
machines.operation: serves customers who want a cup or a small bag, apart
outputs: an extra lane for small orders (1.5/1.2/0.9 s)
machines.marginal: small orders no longer wait behind large ones

machines.name: Menu Display Board
machines.motion: the board lights what is in stock
machines.operation: lets new customers choose among what is in stock

contract.substitution: a new customer orders a size that is on the shelf (later also flavors)

outputs: fewer orders for what is not there
machines.marginal: fewer customers wait for a size that is out

machines.name: Self-Service Kiosk
machines.motion: a screen lights and a bag drops
machines.operation: a slower extra lane when every lane is busy
outputs: a sale
machines.queue: takes the next customer only when the lanes are busy
machines.marginal: +20 customers a minute when the counter is the limit

machines.name: Multi-Lane Serving Robot
machines.motion: a robot with arms slides along the counter
machines.operation: serves at extra counter lanes
outputs: 2/3/4 more counter lanes
machines.marginal: up to 6 counter lanes; with kiosks and the express window, 8

machines.name: Maintenance Robot
machines.motion: a robot rolls from machine to machine
machines.operation: keeps the line running when the wallet runs low

contract.pays_first: machines that make, pack or hand over goods

outputs: below 20 coins helpers stop first; kettles, packers and lanes keep their coins
machines.marginal: no stalled kettles while a helper eats the last coins

machines.name: Lubrication Station
machines.motion: an arm oils the machines beside it
machines.operation: oils the machines beside it
outputs: the places beside it on its floor run 10/15/20% faster
machines.marginal: two neighbours a tenth faster

machines.name: Energy Saver
machines.motion: a leaf glows while its floor works
machines.operation: lowers the upkeep of working machines on its floor
outputs: upkeep 25/35/45% lower on its floor
machines.marginal: a quarter of a busy floor's upkeep

machines.name: Buffer Lift
machines.motion: a lift carries crates between the floors
machines.operation: adds real buffer room between floors
outputs: the raw bin +12/24/36 portions, the shelf +4/6/8 packs
machines.marginal: kettles block less, rushes find packs

machines.name: Quality Inspector
machines.motion: a lens checks each lot
machines.operation: sends true rejects to a bargain SKU

contract.for: customers who ask for a bargain

outputs: bargain packs (price 7) sold only to customers who ask; plain packs stay good
machines.marginal: burnt and early lots stop pulling plain prices down

machines.name: Sanitation Bot
machines.motion: a bot leaves a trail of bubbles
machines.operation: keeps stored popcorn fresh
outputs: no aging
machines.marginal: none until stock ages

machines.name: Demand Scheduler
machines.motion: a calendar flips to the next rush
machines.operation: orders packing by the news and preferences
outputs: the right flavor first
machines.marginal: none until news and flavors (Steps 34, 37)

machines.name: Route Balancer
machines.motion: arrows swap between two lines
machines.operation: moves goods from a blocked line to an idle one

contract.move: a lot at a time per line, the oldest first

inputs: goods in a stopped or crowded line
outputs: the same goods in an idle line
machines.queue: needs two parallel packing lines; moves 1/2/3 lots at once
machines.marginal: a paused or crowded packing line's popcorn reaches an idle filler instead of waiting
